summary: Iteration 90 - Bank Integration States Simplification tested and fixed. Changed from 6 states (Negoc., DESA, SQA, Imple., PreProd, Completado) to 3 states (PreProd, Primer Prod, Masificación). Added data migration layer to handle existing database records with old states. Email notification on status change is SIMULATED (logs to backend console).
